The same code in the documentation's later tracking example: HuaHan's warehouse in Shenzhen received the parcel.
The latest-event summary form of the arrival at HuaHan's operations centre, in the documentation's later tracking example.

In the tracking example of HuaHan's API documentation: the latest-event summary form of the departure from the operations centre.
HuaHan's receipt at its origin facility in its English words, relayed by a tracking provider under the provider's own code: the wording gives the stage.
HuaHan's departure from its origin facility in its English words, relayed the same way.
Relayed by 17TRACK without a code, between the parcel's departures from the origin facility.
The parcel moving from the origin facility to the departure airport.
Export clearance at the origin, before the flight.
The flight leaving the origin.
Import clearance opening at the destination gateway.
The flight landing at the destination gateway.
Import clearance released, before the hand-off to the destination carrier.

entries.wording: Has been given to local carrier

entries.wording: We will pick up your parcel from the sender soon.
entries.note: The destination carrier's notice from its pre-advice, between the order data and HuaHan's receipt in Shenzhen.

entries.wording: The parcel was redirected. As soon as it is in the couriers possession, it will be processed as requested.
entries.note: The destination carrier's record of the recipient's redirection, written while the parcel was still in China: it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Ready to Ship, Parcel received and processed

Relayed without a code after the destination carrier's receipt.
The destination carrier's record of a new delivery address, relayed without a code after the hand-off; the parcel is still on its way.

entries.wording: The parcel is in the central warehouse waiting to be processed.

The courier will deliver the parcel soon. Additional details are available in the SAMEDAY app, email or SMS.

The destination carrier's delivery, relayed under HuaHan's code with that carrier's wording.
